program: M5Q — Q8_0 / Q4_K_M Quantized GGUF Qualification

claim_scope.primary_question: Does each frozen quantized target preserve the qualified F16 runtime behavior under the same pinned llama.cpp, fixture, and inference contract?

target_order.rationale: Run one target at a time for traceability. Q8_0 is the lower-distortion quantized control; Q4_K_M follows under unchanged controls.
target_order.note: Q4_K_M is an independent target, not a rescue for Q8_0. A Q8 scientific FAIL is frozen before Q4 executes.

comparison_contract.no_degradation_definition: quantized task vector and accuracy must equal the frozen F16 parent and outputs must remain format-valid
comparison_contract.limitation: Because the parent frozen task vector is [false,false], this preservation gate is not an absolute-capability test.

non_blocking_parent_observation.rule: Do not reinterpret Q8/Q4 preservation PASS as proof of absolute task capability. Do not redesign the frozen parent benchmark inside this qualification.

adjudication.PASS: all required gates pass for the target
adjudication.FAIL_QUANTIZATION: quantizer exits nonzero or target artifact is missing/invalid
adjudication.FAIL_RUNTIME: quantized artifact cannot load or produce valid outputs under real llama-cli
adjudication.FAIL_PRESERVATION: task vector, accuracy, or format parity differs from the frozen F16 parent
adjudication.FAIL_REASONING_MAPPING: artifact-specific reasoning runtime mapping gate fails
adjudication.INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE: execution venue/tooling fails before a target adjudication artifact is emitted
